appointments_empty_body: Book a meeting with the registrar, a teaching office or another desk: you’ll find it here, with the check-in QR.
appointments_device_note: Bookings are kept on this device: the offices’ portal doesn’t list them. Booked one elsewhere?
appointments_device_note_action: Add it with its code and email
appointments_section_career_caption: Transfers, course changes and your academic career
appointments_section_other_caption: Student grants, international, orientation and more
appointments_qr_hint: Show it at the desk when you arrive.
appointments_qr_missing: The portal sent no QR for this booking: the code is all the desk needs.
appointments_ended_note: This appointment has ended. It will leave this list tomorrow.
appointments_cancel_hint: Cancel the appointment so another student can book the slot.
appointments_cancel_offline: You’re offline: you can cancel once you’re back online.
appointments_cancel_message: You’re about to cancel “{service}” on {date}. This can’t be undone: the slot will become available to other students.
appointments_cancelled_body: The slot on {date} is free again for other students.
appointments_confirmed_body: You’ll find it here under Offices, with the check-in QR and the PDF reminder.
appointments_confirmed_video: You’ll find it here under Offices, with the video call link and the PDF reminder.
appointments_not_found_body: It isn’t among this device’s bookings: it may have been cancelled or have ended.
appointments_add_description: Enter the code and the email used to book: you’ll find them in the portal’s confirmation email.
appointments_add_not_found: No booking with this code and email.
appointments_add_offline: You’re offline: you can look the booking up once you’re back online.
appointments_directory_empty_body: The portal offers no offices right now. Try again later.
appointments_day_full: Every time on this day is taken.
appointments_slot_gone: The time you picked is no longer free: choose another.
appointments_desk_unavailable_body: This office isn’t taking bookings right now. Try again later.

match.countPlural=one: There are no free times in the next day. Offices open new dates all the time: try again later.
match.countPlural=other: There are no free times in the next {count} days. Offices open new dates all the time: try again later.

appointments_recap_none: Pick a day and a time
appointments_form_prefilled: We filled in your account’s details: check them before booking.
appointments_field_consent: Your consent is needed to book
appointments_email_hint: The booking is made out to this address: you’ll need it to manage it.
appointments_gdpr_suffix: on the processing of personal data
appointments_form_no_time: Pick a time for the appointment first.
appointments_offline_book: You’re offline: you can book once you’re back online.
appointments_confirm_body: The office will hold the time for you. If you then can’t make it, you can cancel it here.
appointments_booking_slow: The portal asks for a short wait before confirming: it can take up to 15 seconds. Don’t close the page.
appointments_booking_rejected: The office didn’t accept the booking: the time may have just been taken, or you may have reached this office’s booking limit.
appointments_booking_taken: Someone else booked this time just before you.
appointments_booking_pick_another: The times shown are up to date: pick another one.
appointments_booking_captcha: This office can only be booked on the Portale Planning website.
appointments_booking_no_code: The portal returned no booking code, without which you couldn’t manage the booking. The hold will lapse by itself within half an hour.
appointments_booking_email: Enter the email the booking should be made out to.
appointments_booking_released: No time was left on hold: you can try again or pick another one.
appointments_booking_still_held: The office may keep the time on hold for up to half an hour: if it still shows as taken, pick another one.
appointments_pdf_hint: The portal’s summary, to save or print
appointments_calendar_hint: An event for your calendar app
appointments_video_hint: The meeting is a video call: join it with “Join” at the appointment time.
